compiled_state.title: llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh: staged->main PR whose scope is fully sub-PR-covered -> 'refusing to SKIP an unprovenanced range on an empty diff', llm-review fails closed and blocks merge
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

On a two-tier staged->main PR (#531) whose entire integration scope was already covered by a merged sub-PR (PR1 #530, review-sub-pr passed), the llm-review CI job failed with:
  ERROR: refusing to SKIP an unprovenanced range on an empty diff — fail-closed
(llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh:485). INTEGRATION_SCOPE_COUNT=3, INTEGRATION_SCOPE_EMPTY=false, but the net integration diff is empty (all files covered), and the provenance step marks a SHA in origin/main..staged unprovenanced -> dispatch-or-skip refuses to skip -> exit 1 -> llm-review fails -> PR2 blocked.

## Suspected root cause
The staged branch's MERGE COMMIT (created when PR1 merged into staged) is flagged unprovenanced by verify-session-provenance.sh, which (unlike the just-fixed review-coverage-invariant.sh) has NO clean-merge exemption — its A3b self-merge guard excludes the covering sub-PR, so the merge commit looks unprovenanced. The opus security review of the coverage-invariant fix explicitly flagged this verifier divergence. Likely fix: mirror the clean-merge exemption into verify-session-provenance.sh's SHA walk so a clean staged merge commit is exempt.

## Expected
A staged->main PR fully covered by reviewed sub-PRs should SKIP integration review cleanly (or dispatch only the genuinely-uncovered net diff), not fail closed on the staged merge commit.

comments.body: ROOT_CAUSE (high confidence, empirically reproduced): verify-session-provenance.sh walks git log BASE..HEAD (line 671) with no clean-merge exemption; the staged clean merge commit is enumerated, its only covering sub-PR is dropped by the A3b self-merge guard (line 534), so it is flagged unprovenanced -> dispatcher cannot build a non-empty net diff for a merge commit -> fail-closed at llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh:485. Fix: ported _is_clean_merge (>=2 parents AND empty git diff-tree --cc; fail-closed; evil merges not exempt) into the verifier walk, exempting clean merges before the covering-PR lookup. TDD: t15 (RED before fix - clean merge exempt), t15b (anti-laundering - unreviewed parent still flagged), t16 (evil merge still flagged). 18/18 cases; other verifier suites 35/35,2/2,5/5; shellcheck clean. Opus security review of the verifier-delta in progress.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Opus security review (verifier-delta): APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES. Required change (doc-only) applied: corrected the misleading 'mirror' comment + noted the shared review-coverage-lib.sh predicate must NOT get the carve-out (it is the fail-closed backstop). 18/18 cases green post-edit.
